channel.title: World Boxing News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from World Boxing News (worldboxingnews.net)

item.title: The Other Itauma: How Moses’ Rise Left His Older Brother Behind
item.description: As Moses Itauma accelerates toward a world title at 21, his older brother Karol’s career tells a quieter story of boxing’s unforgiving margins.

item.title: Anthony Ogogo’s Third Act: After Boxing’s Rock Bottom and AEW
item.description: After boxing injuries and an interrupted AEW run, Anthony Ogogo reflects on his lowest point and explains how his career’s third act helps others.

item.title: U.S. Marshals Assist Police After Arrest Warrant Issued for Gervonta Davis
item.description: Florida law enforcement confirmed the U.S. Marshals Service is assisting Miami Police following an arrest warrant issued for Gervonta Davis.

item.title: Cinco de Mayo in Las Vegas: Ramírez Focused on Titles Over Canelo
item.description: Gilberto ‘Zurdo’ Ramírez discusses headlining Cinco de Mayo weekend in Las Vegas, his title ambitions, and Canelo Álvarez talk.

item.title: Arturo Gatti Jr Laid to Rest as Family Seeks Unity
item.description: Arturo Gatti Jr has now been laid to rest, a family member has told World Boxing News, as relatives seek unity while the case remains ongoing.

item.title: 0–10 Heavyweight Dropped 53 Pounds to 168 — Same Outcome
item.description: A winless heavyweight attempted a dramatic 53-pound weight cut down to 168 pounds early in his career. The outcome, however, never changed.

item.title: Usyk vs Wilder announcement absent at San Francisco press event
item.description: Oleksandr Usyk and Deontay Wilder were not announced at I Visit Boxing’s San Francisco press event, with organizers confirming July 11 plans.

item.title: Zuffa Boxing enters boxing with signing of Jai Opetaia
item.description: Zuffa Boxing has entered the professional boxing market by signing Jai Opetaia, signaling a credibility-first approach rather than a takeover.

item.title: Oleksandr Usyk Offers Support for Wladimir Klitschko Comeback
item.description: Oleksandr Usyk has offered personal support to Wladimir Klitschko should the former heavyweight champion decide to return to boxing.

item.title: The Shift in Deontay Wilder’s Career Few Are Ready to Acknowledge
item.description: Questions are growing around Deontay Wilder’s career as Carl Froch reflects on what has changed and how the heavyweight is now being viewed.
